title: Practice in Al-Haqqah: noon, meem and meeting letters together: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Practice in Al-Haqqah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 17. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Slow, steady, normal
points: 2: steady, rules only in the head

keywords.def: a nasal sound held for two counts

questions.q: Annotate and read 69:32 «ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ».
questions.a: ثُمَّ ghunnah on مّ; سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا ikhfa; ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ ikhfa; raa in ذِرَاعًا heavy (fathah); qalqalah none.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite 69:25 to 36 at normal pace; your partner ticks each rule on the rule map (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 69:13 to 30.
questions.a: Partner sheet ticked; teacher records rota scores and targets.
طَعَامٌ إِلَّا izhar; مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ izhar; 69:37 لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا: madd before hamza, 4 or 5 counts.

questions.q: Stretch: explain why the raa in ذِرَاعًا is heavy.

questions.a: A) Ikhfa. Tanween before ذ: ذ is an ikhfa letter.

questions.q: Think again: A rule you can name is not yet a rule you can use. What turns knowing into doing?
questions.a: Practice in real ayat, slowly, then at normal pace, with someone listening.
